item.title: Northampton sons Josh Kennedy and Harry Taylor honoured to be inducted into the WA Football Hall of Fame
item.description: Northampton champions Josh Kennedy and Harry Taylor have further cemented their places in WA footy folklore, when the junior teammates turned great mates were both inducted into the Hall of Fame this week.

item.title: Walk on in: Geraldton Buccaneers secure services of two-time NBL1 MVP and championship star Devondrick Walker
item.description: The Geraldton Buccaneers have revealed another huge signing as preparations for their title defence ramp up, calling on the services of two-time NBL1 West MVP Devondrick Walker for the 2026 season.

item.title: Local retailers urged to address excessive stockpiling, while Geraldton retailer fined $1000 by FuelWatch
item.description: Motorists have been urged to stop panic buying fuel, as prices hit as much as $2.30/L in Geraldton and some retailers are close to running dry.

item.title: State Government backs e-scooter safety recommendations two months after Geraldton extends Beam contract
item.description: The WA State Government is calling for the Federal Government to regulate e-rideable use as the future of hireable e-scooters in Geraldton is still up in the air.

item.title: State Parliament stops for condolence motion to pay tribute to former Geraldton MLA, the late Shane Hill
item.description: WA Parliament stood still and united on Wednesday as MPs from all sides of politics paid tribute to former Geraldton MLA Shane Hill.

item.title: Geraldton marathon swimmer Joanne Norman becomes first Aussie woman to finish prestigious Oceans Seven crown
item.description: Geraldton born marathon swimmer Joanne Norman has officially become the first Australian woman to tackle some of the world’s toughest channels and complete the prestigious Oceans Seven.

item.title: Entire Geraldton Aquarena to be closed for three weeks due to unforeseen complications, scheduled maintenance
item.description: Keen swimmers looking to cool off with a plunge or pace a couple of laps in Geraldton’s public pool will have to wait three weeks while maintenance and repair works are carried out.

item.title: Geraldton Buccaneers great and championship captain Aaron Ralph announces retirement after fairytale finish
item.description: Geraldton Buccaneers premiership-winning captain Aaron Ralph has called time on his NBL1 basketball career, ending it on a high after claiming a league record and third championship ring.

item.title: Mining company accused of turning blind eye to community concerns about iron ore contamination in Geraldton
item.description: Geraldton locals are calling for aid to fight against mining companies bringing in dusty trains to the town and wharf, leaving dirty and damaging residue behind.

item.title: Port Denison bushfire: Emergency order in place, people told to ‘leave now’ as blaze burns near Dongara
item.description: An emergency bushfire warning is in place as a bushfire threatens lives and homes.
